content: pytest-cov 7.0 REMOVED built-in subprocess support (COV_CORE_*/pytest-cov.pth era ended). Subprocess coverage now requires coverage.py patch = subprocess config ([tool.coverage.run] patch = ['subprocess'] in pyproject), which auto-enables parallel=true. SIF dev env has pytest-cov 7.1.0 + coverage 7.13.5 installed, so subprocess test code lines will NOT count toward fail_under=90 unless that config is added. Simpler alternative: in-suite tests cover the shared code paths; subprocess tests assert outcomes only.
